skills.summary: Interview you on a plan until gaps close
skills.job: Ask one question at a time about a plan or idea until the gaps are closed, then summarize the decisions.

skills.summary: Run a weekly review and set next week
skills.job: Walk through last week, clear loose ends and choose the few outcomes for next week.
triggers: what did I get done this week
gotchas: review turns into a to-do dump

skills.summary: Build a realistic plan for one day
skills.job: Turn a task list and a calendar into a plan for today that fits the hours available.
triggers: I have too much to do
gotchas: planning more than the free hours

skills.summary: Sort tasks by urgency and impact
skills.job: Place a task list on an impact and effort grid and name what to do, schedule, delegate or drop.

skills.summary: Log a decision with reasons to review later
skills.job: Record a decision, its options, assumptions and expected result so it can be judged later.
triggers: I want to remember why I chose this

skills.summary: Draft a timed agenda with a purpose
skills.job: Write an agenda with a purpose, timed items, owners and the decisions needed.
gotchas: times that do not add up

skills.job: Compress recent work into done, next and blocked lines a team can read in a minute.

skills.summary: Facilitate a team retro with actions
skills.job: Run a retrospective from a period of work and end with a few owned actions.

skills.summary: Draft objectives and measurable key results
skills.job: Turn a direction into one to three objectives with key results that can be measured.

skills.summary: Design a habit tracker that stays simple
skills.job: Define a few habits with cues, minimum versions and a tracking layout the user will keep up.
triggers: help me stick to a habit
gotchas: tracking tool harder than the habit

skills.summary: Block time on a calendar for real work
skills.job: Place tasks into calendar blocks with buffers, matched to the hours the person has.

skills.summary: Clear a backlog of messages by category
skills.job: Sort a pile of messages or notes into act, schedule, delegate and archive with a clearing routine.
triggers: my inbox is out of control

skills.summary: Write a brief to hand a task to someone
skills.job: Write a handoff brief with outcome, limits, deadline, context and how to check in.
triggers: write a brief for my assistant

skills.summary: Write a handoff note for work in progress
skills.job: Write a document that lets someone else take over ongoing work without asking the author.
Define one outcome, a time box, a setup and a stop rule for a single focus session.
gotchas: outcome too big for the box

skills.summary: Imagine failure to find risks early
skills.job: Assume the plan failed, list the causes, rank them and add preventions and early signals.
triggers: what could go wrong with this plan

skills.summary: Build a checklist for a repeat task
skills.job: Turn a recurring task into a short ordered checklist with checks that can be verified.

skills.summary: Document how a process works step by step
skills.job: Capture a process as roles, inputs, steps, exceptions and a flow others can follow.
triggers: write down how we do this
gotchas: documenting the ideal not the real flow
